title: Toast stack
summary: The live region that holds toasts at one screen position, shows at most three at once and queues the rest; PkToast.show(message, options) creates one per position on demand.

props.name: max
props.description: Visible at once; the rest queue.

writes.why: Toasts past max are hidden until an earlier one is dismissed, and the visible ones are started (their timer). Kept when the element disconnects.

a11y: A labelled region; each toast announces itself with its own role.
mobile: Spans the width on a phone (top or bottom); respects env(safe-area-inset-*).
